decision_log.decision: Keep both project-scoped names: NEO NVM for orchestration, NEO BVM for Bitcoin execution
Use existing Bitcoin witness-v0 Script; do not invent Bitcoin consensus opcodes or require Ethereum
Gate 1 is a bounded local hashlock prototype; Bitcoin Core remains the validation authority for future node tests
Receipt hashes identify local summaries and are never represented as on-chain proofs
Integrate approved Gate 1 runtime with Gate 2 PR #1268 and share one Script emitter without changing the original variable-length profile
Keep application RPC read-only; native fixture mining and reorg controls use only a newly spawned isolated node
Bind actual witness, txid, wtxid, single prevout, weight and fees before treating Core mempool acceptance as usable local evidence
Delegate IF, ECDSA and CLTV execution to Core; do not expand the local subset with simulated signature success
Bind a public-key-only signed approval to exact PSBT bytes, normalized intent, five-minute expiry and one atomic nonce; snapshot authenticated fields before RPC
Keep Ed25519 operator approval distinct from Bitcoin ECDSA and from unconnected NEOpass identity; fixture signing remains test-only
Require a dedicated SQLite WAL/FULL store with one primary-key insert; keep consumed nonce history through expiry and key rotation
Reuse the platform NEOpass verifier with mandatory bounded session times; require current registry identity and a separately provisioned public approval key, with no role-claim or executive fallback
Repeat identity checks around reservation, burn nonces on uncertain post-reservation results, and treat review receipts as audit results rather than deferred signing authority
Perform fresh full identity/operator approval before each external call; do not accept prior review receipts as signing authority
Bind an authenticated bounded request to a pinned device response and original operator proof; require device-side identity permissions, user presence and its own durable nonce reservation
Independently parse returned wire bytes and require exact intent, txid/wtxid/fee/weight and fresh Core policy checks; return audit hashes without broadcasting
Abort on timeout without retry; retain consumed approvals because an external signature may already exist
